title: Ali's School Day
text:
Ali is a student. He goes to school in the morning. His favourite lesson is science. He likes to learn about animals and plants.

On Monday, Ali has a maths lesson. The maths teacher is very kind. She helps the students with difficult numbers. After school, Ali reads a book about the planets.

questions.text: What does Ali read after school?
How does Ali probably feel about science?
What kind of teacher is the maths teacher?
options: A teacher who is always late
A teacher who does not speak

vocabulary.definition: the study of nature and how things work
living things such as dogs, cats or birds
living things that grow in soil and need sunlight
large objects that travel around a star

paragraph_translations: Ali bir öğrenci. Sabahları okula gider. En sevdiği ders fen bilgisi. Hayvanlar ve bitkiler hakkında öğrenmeyi sever.
Pazartesi günü Ali'nin matematik dersi var. Matematik öğretmeni çok nazik. Öğrencilere zor sayılarda yardım eder. Okuldan sonra Ali gezegenler hakkında bir kitap okur.
